info.name: Admin Settings
info.description:
Platform-wide configuration toggles managed by admins.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}

All endpoints require a JWT for a user with role ADMIN.

There is a single settings record for the whole platform (no ID needed in the URL). Reads are cached; updates invalidate the cache immediately.

Fields:
- maintenanceMode (boolean): when true, all non-ADMIN requests receive 503 except POST /auth/login and POST /auth/refresh-token.
- registrationEnabled (boolean): when false, POST /auth/register, telegram-login auto-register, and Google OAuth auto-register are all rejected with 403 for new accounts.
- maxPropertiesPerLandlord (integer): max properties a landlord may create within a rolling 30-day window.
- maxImagesPerProperty (integer): max images allowed per property.
- minPropertyPrice / maxPropertyPrice (number, nullable): allowed monthly_price range on property create/update. Null means no bound.
- commissionRate (number): stored platform commission rate, not yet enforced anywhere — reserved for future billing/reporting.

request.description:
Returns the current platform settings.

Errors:
- 401: Missing/invalid token
- 403: Requester is not an ADMIN

Partially updates platform settings. All fields optional — only send the ones you want to change.

Errors:
- 400: minPropertyPrice greater than maxPropertyPrice, or invalid field types
